summary: A complex, asymmetrical fortress or industrial-style building characterized by prominent horizontal striped walls and three distinct towers of varying heights. The structure features flat brick roofs with overhangs, a central glass skylight, and is surrounded by a perimeter of spaced white blocks.

shape.overall_form: multi-tiered blocky structure with corner and end towers

materials.name: stonebrick
materials.role: tower walls and structural accents on main walls

materials.name: wood
materials.role: tan horizontal wall bands and vertical tower stripes

materials.name: quartz
materials.role: white horizontal wall bands, roof borders, and perimeter markers

rebuild_hints: Begin by laying out the complex, asymmetrical I-shaped footprint.
Construct the main walls using alternating horizontal bands of white blocks and tan blocks, separated by occasional dark grey accents.
Build the three towers at the extremities of the footprint, ensuring the central-left tower is significantly taller than the other two.
Cap the main building with a flat roof made of bricks, bordered by white blocks.
Add overhanging flat roofs to the towers using stone slabs and bricks, and place a light source (like glowstone) on the very top center of each.
Construct a small glass skylight structure on the main central roof.
Surround the base of the building with a perimeter of evenly spaced white blocks.
uncertainties: Exact material IDs for the white and tan blocks are uncertain; they could be quartz/concrete and birch wood/sandstone respectively.
The interior layout, floor divisions, and lighting are completely hidden from view.
Exact block dimensions are estimated from visual counting and may be slightly off.
